title: Faithfulness of God
definition: The faithfulness of God means that God is perfectly reliable, keeping His promises, covenant, Word, and purposes.
summary: God is faithful and never fails to keep His Word.
christFocus: Jesus fulfills God's promises and proves the faithfulness of God in salvation.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's faithfulness means He is trustworthy in all He says and does. He does not forget His promises, abandon His people, or fail in His purposes.

His faithfulness is seen in covenant promises, daily mercies, discipline, forgiveness, preservation, and final salvation. Even when believers are weak, God remains faithful to His character.

Christ is the yes and amen of God's promises. In Him, believers see that God keeps His Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Broken promises and human failure can make trust difficult. The faithfulness of God matters because it gives believers confidence that the Lord will not betray, forget, or abandon His people.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Remember specific ways God has been faithful. Trust His promises when feelings waver, and practice faithfulness in your own commitments as a reflection of His character.
